title: Cross Site Scripting (XSS) in the Markdown renderer of Apache JSPWiki 2.11.0 through 3.0.0 on all platforms, when the…
description: A Cross Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in the Markdown renderer of Apache JSPWiki versions 2.11.0 through 3.0.0 when Markdown syntax is enabled. This flaw allows an attacker with page editing privileges to inject JavaScript code that executes in the browsers of visitors viewing the affected page. The vulnerability arises because the text and URL of inline images are inserted into the img element attributes without proper encoding. Upgrading to version 3.0.1 or applying the backported fix in 2.12.6 resolves this issue.
